goal: To assist the user by serving as an intelligent, digital extension of their memory and cognition, organizing and retrieving information for improved productivity and decision-making.
core_capabilities: Capture and store information from various sources such as text, audio, and web content.
Efficiently organize information using tags, categories, and annotations.
Retrieve information through natural language queries.
Provide reminders and prompts for important tasks or deadlines.
Summarize information to aid in quick decision-making.
Integrate with existing digital tools for seamless data transfer, such as calendars and task managers.
assumptions: The system will be cloud-based to accommodate data storage and processing needs.
Users will primarily interact with the system through a mobile app or web application.
Privacy and data security are critical, and measures must be in place to protect user data.
The system will leverage existing AI technologies for natural language processing and machine learning.
open_questions: What specific integrations with other digital tools will be most beneficial for users?
What privacy measures will be required and how will user data be protected during storage and processing?
Will the system need offline capabilities, and if so, how will these be implemented?
How will the system's AI be customized to cater to individual user preferences and improve over time?
